facts.fact: Version 1.0 of the Mauritius e-Government Interoperability Framework, dated November 2002, sets technical standards and specifications for interoperability across government information systems and for data exchange between public agencies.

systems.tiers: all digital services developed, procured or maintained by ministries and departments

note: Communique of 2026-09-01 says a Digital Service Framework will be developed with principles and standards including interoperability; a framework still to be written, with no standards for data exchange stated, so no fact.
